subject: AtlasSight private-offer MAP, procurement checklist & target PO timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@atlassight.com>, Melissa Ngo <melissa.ngo@atlassight.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AtlasSight MAP + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP) + target PO date

Hi Sam / Melissa,

Thanks again for the conversation today — attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones for the private-offer route you asked about. This MAP assumes you prefer marketplace billing (AWS Private Offer), but I included the alternate Azure/GCP steps in the appendix in case procurement prefers those.

Key asks for procurement to confirm:
- Preferred marketplace (AWS / Azure / GCP) and billing contact
- Any specific invoicing terms (net30, PO number format, supplier name)
- SOC 2 / security artifact recipients (who on your side should I share the evidence with?)

Target timeline (proposed):
- Private offer creation by Redwood: within 48 hours after pricing sign-off
- AtlasSight legal review: 7 business days
- PO issuance target: 2026-12-15

Attachments: AtlasSight_MAP_v1.xlsx, AWS_Private_Offer_Checklist.pdf
HubSpot record: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/AS-2026-0321

If you prefer to take the direct invoice route instead of marketplace we can discuss — marketplace is usually faster for procurement approvals. Let me know who should receive the SOC2 pack, and whether the PO needs to route to aws-po@amazon.com (or a vendor email).

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: AtlasSight_MAP_v1.xlsx] [Attachment: AWS_Private_Offer_Checklist.pdf]

From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@atlassight.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Melissa Ngo <melissa.ngo@atlassight.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasSight MAP + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP) + target PO date

Thanks, Jasmine — appreciate the clear map. A few items from procurement/legal we need clarified before we can move to a PO:

1) Billing path: AtlasSight prefers AWS Private Offer so the invoice hits our AWS reseller/chargeback. Please confirm Redwood will create and send the private-offer link to aws-po@amazon.com and cc our billing alias (procurement@atlassight.com).
2) Pricing: we need a per-month and annualized price table and confirmation of any committed usage discounts.
3) Security: legal wants SOC 2 Type II evidence and data retention policy. Send directly to elle.legal@atlassight.com.
4) Contract: our legal team will need the MSA with Redwood redlines; estimated 7 business days for review.

I've attached our PO template for reference. If you can give an estimated date when the private-offer link will be available that helps our internal schedule.

Best,
Sam Tucker
Head of Procurement, AtlasSight
[Attachment: AS_PO_Template.pdf]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: AtlasSight MAP — action owners & timeline (AWS PO)

Team — looping you in so we can hit their 12/15 PO target. Quick plan and asks:

- Ben: can you finalize the pricing grid (monthly/annual, committed tiers) and attach to the private-offer? I will need the final CSV by EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik: please confirm who on Marketplace ops will submit the AWS Private Offer and which seller account will be used (we have two seller IDs this quarter). Aim to create the offer once pricing is confirmed.
- Laura: heads-up in case legal needs to expedite the MSA for a faster turnaround; AtlasSight asked for 7 business days. If we need to compress, let me know and I’ll ask for a 3-day canary review with their legal.

I replied to Sam asking for the billing alias and SOC2 recipient (elle.legal@atlassight.com). CC'd below is their PO template they sent.

Thanks — Jasmine
[Quoted message below]
> From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@atlassight.com>
> Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: AtlasSight MAP + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP) + target PO date
> ...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@atlassight.com>, Melissa Ngo <melissa.ngo@atlassight.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasSight MAP + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP) + target PO date

Hi Sam / Melissa — thanks for the quick turnaround on the PO template. Per our internal discussion, attaching: AtlasSight_MAP_v2.xlsx and Pricing_Grid_AtlasSight.csv which include the committed tiers and an annualized view.

To confirm operational steps:
- Redwood will create the AWS Private Offer and send the private-offer link to aws-po@amazon.com and procurement@atlassight.com (cc'd) once AtlasSight confirms final pricing table.
- Expected timing: we can have the private-offer created within 48 hours of pricing sign-off.
- SOC2 pack will be shared with elle.legal@atlassight.com by end of day today.

Please confirm if 2026-12-15 remains your target for PO issuance; if so we will prioritize marketplace ops.

Attachments: AtlasSight_MAP_v2.xlsx, Pricing_Grid_AtlasSight.csv

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: AtlasSight_MAP_v2.xlsx] [Attachment: Pricing_Grid_AtlasSight.csv]

From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@atlassight.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Melissa Ngo <melissa.ngo@atlassight.com>, procurement@atlassight.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasSight MAP + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP) + target PO date

Ben / Jasmine — all looks good. Legal confirmed they need 5–7 business days for the MSA review; procurement will route the PO to aws-po@amazon.com once legal clears language.

We will aim for PO issuance on 2026-12-15, pending minor redlines. Please go ahead and create the private-offer and send the link to aws-po@amazon.com (cc procurement@atlassight.com). I will confirm the exact billing alias tomorrow.

Thanks for moving quickly on the SOC2 share — I have asked Elle to expect the evidence.

Best,
Sam Tucker
Head of Procurement | AtlasSight
[Attachment: none]
